phase_name: Part A whole-tree-claim admission dimension and schema v7

objectives.description: Define reserved sentinel constant in lib/file-scope-overlap.sh
Add new dimension in orchestrate-batch-admit.sh (resolving Phase 2's design finding)
Add whole_tree_claim:true to every sentinel verdict
Bump $schema to v7 at every enumerated site
Confirm sentinel trips neither validate-state.sh Check 8 nor Check 11

approaches_tried.approach: Resolve Phase 2's design finding by appending the new dimension as a literal LAST, separate evaluation stage after the existing collision scan completes
approaches_tried.reason: the existing collision scan's own $hit computation already consumes the sentinel-vs-sentinel exact match and returns a non-null $hit, so a trailing stage would never be reached for that case (confirmed by Phase 2's red fixtures) -- a bolt-on last stage cannot fire when an earlier stage already produced a (wrongly-labeled) defer

approaches_tried.approach: Relabel the existing $hit collision in place: when $hit.ov_path equals whole_tree_claim_sentinel, branch to a whole_tree_claim-shaped verdict (with its own phase-map exemption) instead of falling through to the plain file_scope_collision verdict; leave $hit's own selection/deferral-direction logic completely untouched
approaches_tried.reason: resolves the design tension without editing the collision scan's selection logic at all -- only the verdict SHAPE built from an already-selected $hit differs by inspecting which path it matched -- and both previously-red Phase 2 fixtures (WHOLE-TREE-CODISPATCH, WHOLE-TREE-PHASE-EXEMPT) now pass with zero regression

approaches_tried.approach: Bash single-quoted-string apostrophe hazard: the entire jq admission program (lines ~691 onward) is embedded inside ONE bash single-quoted string (`"$FILE_SCOPE_OVERLAP_JQ_DEFS"'...'`), so any English possessive apostrophe ("$hit's", "scopes_overlap_first's", "guardrails.md's") in a newly-added jq comment prematurely closes that string and produces a bash syntax error far from the real cause
approaches_tried.reason: bash -n caught it immediately (line 853 'syntax error near unexpected token'); resolved by rewording every new comment to avoid the possessive apostrophe entirely (e.g. 'the exact-match definition of scopes_overlap_first' instead of "scopes_overlap_first's exact-match definition")

verification.suite_result: 2 suites passed, 0 failed (test-orchestrate-batch-admit.sh: 15 passed/0 failed, up from Phase 2's 13 passed/2 failed red baseline; test-orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh: 382 passed/0 failed, unaffected)

schema_widening_finding.summary: Step 1's enumeration found two consumers of the orchestrate-batch-admit-v6 literal beyond the plan's declared Files-to-modify list for this phase: scripts/orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh (prose comment only) and scripts/test-conflict-predicate.sh (a strict schema-literal pin in its Group 3 non-regression case). Both updated to v7 alongside the planned edits -- mechanical, low-risk, and test-conflict-predicate.sh's pin would otherwise have broken. docs/architecture/batch-admit-schema.md was deliberately LEFT at v6 for now: its Version History entry is Phase 6's own explicitly-assigned task (not Phase 4's Files-to-modify list), and writing a premature partial entry now would leave Phase 6 nothing to do for its own listed task.
